property_summary: For any caller and any input values, a successful call to setL1BlockValues never changes state, so c.sequenceNumber() remains 0; the mutant stores the fuzzed _sequenceNumber, violating this for nonzero values (prank address(0), the zero-initialized depositorAccount, so the require passes in both).
change_summary: Insert an assignment storing the passed _sequenceNumber into the state variable sequenceNumber after the require check, so the value becomes observable via the public sequenceNumber() getter.
